Her Nintendo DS, her treasure true,
A portal to adventures new.
With every tap and every swipe,

Her DS still sat upon the shelf,
A treasure kept, but not for wealth.
For now she knew, both worlds were grand,
But life was best when shared with hand.

So every day, she played a while,
Then stepped outside to run and smile.
Her Nintendo DS, her joy, her friend,
But not the only world to mend.
